themes.title: Far-right push for 'national priority' policies
themes.blurb: Right-wing parties across Europe continue to advocate for policies that prioritize nationals over immigrants in access to public services, housing, and social aid. This theme is particularly strong in Spain, Italy, and Sweden, where Vox, Fratelli d'Italia, Lega, and Sverigedemokraterna are actively promoting or implementing such measures, often in coalition agreements with center-right parties.

countries.name: 🇪🇸 Vox
countries.note: Demands 'national priority' in regional budgets and public aid, clashing with coalition partners like PP in Valencia, Extremadura, and Andalusia.

countries.name: 🇮🇹 Fratelli d'Italia / Lega
countries.note: Supports 'national priority' policies in coalition agreements, particularly in housing and social services.

countries.name: 🇸🇪 Sverigedemokraterna
countries.note: Advocates for policies favoring Swedish nationals in welfare and housing, influencing government coalitions.

countries.name: 🇳🇴 Fremskrittspartiet
countries.note: Proposes stricter immigration controls and prioritization of locals in public services.

countries.name: 🇫🇷 Rassemblement National
countries.note: Promotes 'national preference' in social benefits and housing, central to 2027 presidential campaign.

themes.title: Far-right gains in European local elections

countries.name: 🇪🇸 Vox
countries.note: Increases its share of seats in regional parliaments, particularly in Andalusia and Valencia.

countries.name: 🇩🇪 Alternative für Deutschland
countries.note: Makes gains in local elections, particularly in eastern Germany, with anti-immigration and anti-EU messaging.

countries.name: 🇸🇪 Sverigedemokraterna
countries.note: Strengthens its position in local councils, influencing policies on immigration and welfare.
